triples.tail_surface: remote means of controls situated outside the space in which they are located so that they may be stopped in the event of fire arising in that space
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 位于泵所在处所外部的遥控停止装置
triples.evidence_text: Independently driven fuel oil service pumps, booster pumps, and other pumps serving the same purpose are to be fitted with remote means of controls situated outside the space in which they are located so that they may be stopped in the event of fire arising in that space.

triples.tail_surface: cleaned without interrupting the fuel supply
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在不中断燃油供应的情况下进行清洗
triples.evidence_text: Filters or strainers are to be provided in the fuel oil injection-pump suction lines and are to be arranged such that they can be cleaned without interrupting the fuel supply.

triples.tail_surface: arranged and located so that, in the event of leakage, oil will not spray onto surfaces with temperature in excess of 220°C (428°F)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 布置和定位使泄漏时油不会喷溅到超过220°C的表面上
triples.evidence_text: Filters and strainers are to be arranged and located so that, in the event of leakage, oil will not spray onto surfaces with temperature in excess of 220°C (428°F).
